name: Whirlpool
description: You create a wave of water that swirls around a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {dice} {type} damage and is restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a {save}. On each successive turn, if the creature is still restrained, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit.
